verdict.rationale: The product's own Agent API supports delegating tasks to a Perplexity-hosted agent: a `preset` gives a working agent in one field, and it can run built-in web search, URL fetch, and a sandboxed Linux container. Separately, the Computer MCP server lets an MCP client delegate complex, multi-step work to Computer. All of this is reached programmatically through the API, not through an assistant built into the product's console or UI; the only documented interactive surface is a search Playground with no assistant. Missing for 10: an in-product, UI-embedded assistant that users can hand tasks to, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of agent task delegation.
